source:
@@U03481@@
Greater, ever greater, looming nearer,
the goddess’s encircling throne approaches!
Appalling, monstrous to behold!
Its flames grow dark,
they're turning red!
Gigantic round, come no closer!
You will destroy us all,
land, sea, and man!
It’s true, then, what they say!
Thessalian witches once with wicked magic
chanted you down from your monthly round
and wrested from you the utmost in destruction!
Ah! Darkness now shrouds the luminous shield
that all at once explodes in flames,
showering sparks in every direction!
What a clattering! What a hissing!
The heavens thunder and hurricanes blow!
Goddess, humbly at the foot of your throne
I cast myself! Forgive!
It was I who called it down!

@@U03482@@
(He throws himself prostrate to the ground.)

@@U03484@@
The things this man hears and sees!
I can’t be sure exactly what
happened to us, but I certainly didn’t go through
what he’s been through.
At least we'll agree these are very odd times.
And yet, there’s Luna
rocking away up there
just as she’s always done.

@@U03486@@
Look! The 俾格米侏儒们’ mountain!
Up there!
At first it was rounded,
translation:
@@U03481@@
更大，越来越大，越来越近，
女神的环绕宝座临近！
令人毛骨悚然，令人目瞪口呆！
它的火焰变暗，
他们变红了！
巨大的圆球，不要靠近！
你会毁灭我们所有人，
陆地、海洋和人类！
那么，他们说的是真的！
色萨利女巫曾经拥有邪恶的魔法
把你从每月的回合中喊下来
并以最大程度的破坏从你手中夺走！
啊!黑暗现在笼罩着发光护盾
突然在火焰中爆炸，
火花四溅！
多么哗啦啦！多么嘶嘶啊！
苍天雷霆，飓风袭来！
女神，谦卑地跪在你的宝座下
我投我自己！原谅！
是我叫下来的！

@@U03482@@
（他倒在地上。）

@@U03484@@
这个人所听到和看到的事情！
我不能确定到底是什么
发生在我们身上，但我当然没有经历过
他经历过什么。
至少我们会同意现在是非常奇怪的时期。
然而，还有卢娜
在那里摇晃
就像她一贯做的那样。

@@U03486@@
看！俾格米侏儒们的山！
上面！
一开始是圆形的，
